method: domain adaptation of the paper's two-stage recipe, not literal reproduction

stage2.objective: full language-model and projector instruction tuning
stage2.trainable: all decoder, embedding, language-head and active projector parameters
stage2.selection: highest full development accuracy; tie lower CE; earliest exact tie

optimizer: AdamW with FP32 CPU master weights/moments and copied GPU gradients; no LoRA or quantization
precision: BF16 decoder and autocast; FP32 visual projectors; FP32 CPU optimizer masters and moments
development_evaluation: all 632 questions before stage 2 and after every stage-2 epoch
limitations: 277 training graphs and 2475 QA examples, not the original large datasets
Three-pass small-domain adaptation budget differs from paper epochs/global batches
CPU-master optimizer/offload implementation requires real model and resume gates
No checkpoints from the projector-only ablation are used as stage-2 initializers
No full checkpoints transferred to Mac; backups stay on Apuana
predeclared_contrasts: full-SFT CLIP+DINOv3 minus full-SFT CLIP single
full-SFT CLIP+DINOv3 minus full-SFT CLIP duplicated
full SFT minus projector-only, clearly separate training protocols
